in_marathi.name: Sathishkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's Abode, God's Abode of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sathishkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sathishkumar is a compound name, derived from two Tamil words. Sathi means 'God' and Kumar means 'God's Abode'. The second part of the name, Kumar, can also be translated as 'God's Abode of Prosperity'.
